settings.label: TRIG. GUARD
settings.help: Stops a worn key from playing its note twice. It only watches the 24 note keys.

settings.label: WINDOW MS
settings.help: Press a key again this soon after letting go and it counts as a bounce.

settings.label: WINDOWS
settings.help: PER NOTE times each key on its own. ALL shares one window, so a quick press on another key is dropped too.

settings.label: HOLD RELEASE
settings.help: Holds each release back for the window, so a bounce can't cut the note short. Off lets go at once.

settings.label: KNOB GUARD
settings.help: Stops a worn encoder switch from pushing twice, which flips a page 2 straight back.

settings.label: KNOB MS
settings.help: Push an encoder again this soon after letting go and it counts as a bounce.
